model_name: Ricochet RC-01CA-1 (Concept A Real Components · Rev 1)
description: Ricochet RC-01 Concept A with selected off-the-shelf actuators (Volz DA 30-HT-D, Volz DA 58-D, Exlar GSX30) and hinged planing skis under the outboard sponson pods. Calibrated for passive 100 Hz / 400 Hz operation with Raymer aero_buildup drag and cleared rudder hinge cove. Legacy Concept A is unchanged when no profile is selected.

servo_loop.stiffness_rule: kp = rated torque / 1 deg (assumed: Volz publishes position accuracy, not loop stiffness)

reverse_bucket.hinge_offset_note: Iteration 1 of the hinge-axis placement: 0.11 m (as lofted) gave ~250 N m; moving the axis to 0.04 m from the jet load line gives ~90 N m at 1,450 N per fan.
reverse_bucket.lock_note: Mechanical over-centre lock carries the jet load at full deployment; actuator only moves the bucket.

skis.mass_status: assumed: carbon sandwich planing ski with fin and fittings

actuator.stroke_note: 152.4 mm (6 in) is within the published 76-457 mm range and gives 20 deg travel on a 0.44 m lever.

skis.hydro_model: Calibrated Savitsky planing + regularized submerged plate with C^1 added-inertia ramp, Wagner slamming damping, centroidal heave drag, and 6-strip chordwise pitch-rate damping.
